title: Geometry of $D_4^-$-front singularities and a Gauss-Bonnet type formula
summary: We construct a form of the $D_4^-$-singularity of fronts in $\R^3$ which uses coordinate transformation on the source and isometry on the target. As an application, we compute differential geometric invariants near the $D_4^-$-singularity, and give a Gauss-Bonnet type theorem for one-parameter generic fronts.
